detections.summary: Guest recalls completing an 18-month dialectical behavioral therapy (DBT) program and memorizing the material, but finding it too clinical to apply in her own life, using this as an aside about knowledge versus applied experience.

detections.evidence_quote: it was so clinical in nature that was hard for me to apply in my own life
detections.summary: Her own experience memorizing DBT material yet failing to apply it personally is offered as grounds for the broader claim that intellectual knowledge is not the same as applied experience.
